$comment: Agent-facing catalog for the Screen component library. Pick a component by description, then read props to call it. Each registryUrl resolves to the full source.

components.name: a2ui-surface
components.title: A2UI Surface
components.description: Renders a declarative agent UI payload into real components, with an inspectable JSON source.

props.name: catalog
props.description: Extra renderers merged over the built-in catalog.

components.name: actions
components.title: Actions
components.description: Message action bar with copy, regenerate, like/dislike, share, stop, and reload buttons.

props.name: labels

components.name: activity-feed
components.title: Activity Feed
components.description: Timeline activity feed with avatar/icon/dot prefix types and semantic status colors.

components.name: announcement-bar
components.title: Announcement Bar
components.description: Dismissible page-top announcement bar with icon, message, link, and color variants.

components.name: approval
components.title: Approval
components.description: Ask before an agent sends, refunds, or otherwise leaves the product, with a reason, an expiry, and keyboard shortcuts.

components.name: artifact
components.title: Artifact
components.description: Tabs of files a run produced, with code or image preview and copy, download, and open actions.

components.name: autonomy
components.title: Agent Autonomy
components.description: Choose whether a run asks, waits on the send, or finishes alone, with per-action exceptions and hard limits.

props.name: overrides
props.description: Per-action exceptions. They win over the level above.

props.name: limits
props.description: Hard stops that apply even at auto.

components.name: avatar-group
components.title: Avatar Group
components.description: Stacked avatar group with max display count, overflow badge, and tooltip on hover.

components.name: breadcrumb-nav

components.description: Responsive breadcrumb navigation with custom separator, max items, and home icon support.

components.name: chatbot-code-block

components.description: Syntax-highlighted code display with line numbers, copy, download, and inline code.

components.name: checkpoint
components.title: Checkpoint
components.description: Timeline of run snapshots, each restorable to files, chat, or both.

components.name: color-picker
components.title: Color Picker
components.description: Color picker with preset swatches, hex input, and native color picker fallback in a popover.

components.name: comparison-table

components.description: Feature comparison table with plan columns, check/cross/text cells, and recommended column highlight.

components.name: confetti-button
components.title: Confetti Button
components.description: Button that bursts colourful confetti particles on click.

components.name: conversation
components.title: Conversation
components.description: Chat container with auto-scroll, user/assistant messages, and scroll-to-bottom button.

components.name: count-up

components.description: Animated number counter that counts from a start value to target on viewport entry.

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Increment this value to replay the count-up animation

components.name: cta-banner
components.title: CTA Banner
components.description: Call-to-action banner with fullwidth/card layouts, gradient/solid/subtle backgrounds, and primary/secondary buttons.

components.name: dashboard-layout
components.title: Dashboard Layout

components.title: Data Card
components.description: Collapsible data display cards with 11 semantic variants for different content types.

components.name: data-table
components.title: Data Table
components.description: Sortable data table with striped rows, loading skeletons, pagination support, and empty states.

components.name: date-picker
components.title: Date Picker
components.description: Calendar date picker with month navigation, disabled dates, today shortcut, and clear action.

components.name: diff

components.description: File changes for one run, with per-hunk accept and reject.

components.title: Doc Content
components.description: Content wrapper with styled header, title gradient, description, and prose styling.

components.name: doc-hooks
components.title: Doc Hooks
components.description: useDocsStructure and useTOC hooks for documentation pages.

components.name: doc-layout
components.title: Doc Layout
components.description: Full documentation page layout with sidebar, search, reading progress, and responsive mobile support.

components.name: doc-navigation

components.description: Previous/Next navigation between documentation pages.

components.name: doc-reading-progress
components.title: Doc Reading Progress

components.name: doc-sidebar-navigation

components.name: doc-table-of-contents
components.title: Doc Table of Contents

props.name: header

props.name: footer

props.name: searchComponent
props.description: Custom search component to replace the default

props.name: structureApiEndpoint
props.description: API endpoint to fetch docs structure. Defaults to "/api/docs/structure"

props.name: mobileLabels
props.description: Labels for mobile sidebar

components.name: error-recovery

components.description: A failed step with its reason and the ways out: retry, edit, skip, or switch model.

components.name: eval-badge

components.description: Compact eval verdict that expands into per-metric scores and the run it came from.

components.name: fade-in
components.title: Fade In
components.description: Animate elements into view with configurable fade and directional slide.

props.description: Increment this value to replay the animation

components.name: faq-accordion

components.name: handoff

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (email: string, password: string, remember: boolean) => Promise<void> | void

components.name: logo-banner

components.name: message
components.title: Message

components.name: metric-card

components.name: orbit
components.title: Orbit
components.description: Items orbiting around a center element with configurable speed and radius.

components.name: otp-input

components.description: One-time password input with auto-focus navigation, paste support, and shake error animation.

components.name: particle-burst
components.title: Particle Burst
components.description: Colourful particle explosion on hover, click, or mount.

components.name: pricing-card

components.name: pricing-section

components.name: reasoning

components.name: ripple-button

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Formatted clock, e.g. "01:24".

props.name: cost
props.description: Pre-formatted, e.g. "$0.42".

components.name: shimmer

props.name: replayKey
props.description: Increment this value to replay the animation

props.description: Increment this value to replay the animation

components.title: Terminal
components.description: A command and its output, with exit code and folded long output.

props.name: command
props.description: The command the agent ran, without the prompt.

props.name: cwd
props.description: Optional working directory shown before the prompt.

props.name: exitCode
props.description: 0 is success, anything else is a failure, null means still running.

props.name: maxLines
props.description: Lines kept before the output folds. Defaults to 10.

components.name: testimonial-card

components.name: testimonial-grid

components.name: text-reveal

props.description: Increment this value to replay the text reveal animation
